description: Replays Stake Originals bets from a revealed server seed, client seed and nonce with Stake's provably fair algorithm and reports each result and multiplier, up to 200 nonces per call. Returns the SHA-256 of the server seed to compare with the hash Stake showed before the seed was revealed. Needs the unhashed server seed, which Stake reveals after the pair is rotated.

count.description: How many nonces from the first one

options.description: The bet settings, such as bombCount and gems for Mines or diceTarget and diceIsRollOver for Dice

diceIsRollOver.description: Dice: true for roll over, false for roll under

difficulty.description: Difficulty word for pump, chicken, cases, tarot, darts, bars, snakes and dragon tower

gems.description: Mines: safe tiles revealed before cashing out

kenoPicks.description: Keno: how many numbers are picked

molesRounds.description: Moles: rounds hit before cashing out

rouletteBet.description: Roulette bet such as red, black, odd, even, straight, dozen1

target.description: Multiplier target for pump, chicken, limbo, dice or drill

name: stake_verify_bets
title: Verify Stake bets from a seed pair
